title: 第1029章 暗算你们也配第1028章 屈指如弹星修罗陨
slug: 逆天悟性我在修仙界证道长生
content_zh:
全场一片死寂，连空气都仿佛被玄冰冻结。
弹指斩修罗，这是何等恐怖的战力？！
强如绝空大长老，此刻也不禁心神恍惚，难以相信这残酷的现实。
“他还没有突破大罗境，为何会如此强大？”
苍昊心念电转，瞳孔深处似有万象重生，反复推演着方才那一幕。
自踏入五气圆满，他又打磨了八万个寒暑，最终于精、气、神三道，都走到了传说中的极境。
万劫仙王曾亲口断言：放眼古今诸天，他的根基足以位列前二十，堪称登峰造极。
以仙王的恢弘见识，自然不会走眼——换言之，他在金仙领域的造诣，已不逊于少年时代的仙王！
然而...
“天壤之别...我与他的差距，至少隔着两个层次！”
苍昊眉头紧锁，得出了一个令人窒息的结论。
....
而在对面。
眼见炎狱修罗被一指洞穿，剩余四大老魔早已肝胆俱裂，脚底凉气噌噌往上冒。
“大罗中期....不，这绝对是大罗后期才有的战力！”
不久之前，他们刚目睹自家族长出手，重创凌九霄的盛况。
虽说比起五狱战神那等强者，沈云尚欠几分火候，但毫无疑问，他已站在了同一层次！
更可怕的是，此子如今连大罗金仙都不是，一旦让他渡劫成功，战力必将发生质的飞跃，届时天上地下，还有谁能制得住他？
“绝不能让他突破，否则后果不堪设想！”
仅一刹那，绝空便洞悉了其中利害，眼底杀意轰然沸腾。

哗！！
没有任何迟疑，他直接点燃了空间法则，强行压下体内伤势。
面对这等前所未有的大敌，任何一丝松懈都将致命，他自然不会犯这种低级错误。
下一刻，大罗巅峰的可怕之处，便赤裸裸的展现在众人面前。
“死——！！”
绝空气贯长虹，周身八口混洞齐齐张开，磅礴魔威激荡而出，震得整座涅盘谷隆隆作响。
五行、阴阳、生死、风雷....构成宇宙秩序的万千法则，皆随着他的一念生灭重组！
轰！
磅礴道力极尽升华，最终化作一座冰冷的空间死狱，带着碾碎万物的压迫感，自四面八方朝沈云镇杀而下。
“造化钟灵秀，阴阳割昏晓。”
身处风暴中心的沈云，却依旧神色淡然，宠辱不惊。
他没有正面硬撼，双手于虚空中划出玄奥轨迹，演化出一幅阴阳道图，意图借力打力，四两拨千斤。
显然，他看出了绝空外强中干的本质，准备打一场持久战。
轰！！
然而，在狂暴的空间混洞面前，阴阳法则终究弱了不少，不过几个呼吸，神图便炸开道道裂缝，并以肉眼可见的速度蔓延开来。
“一出手便不留余地，不愧是皇族老祖。”
苍昊目光如电，将绝空那近乎疯狂的攻势尽收眼底，心中迅速权衡利弊。
唰！
下一刻，他身形骤然暴起，化作一道璀璨电弧，径直扑向四大魔头。
苍昊心头雪亮：以他当下的修为，根本无力左右沈云那边的战局，既然如此，倒不如先清理杂兵，再伺机而动。

“该死！他竟把我等当成了软柿子。”
群魔见状怒不可遏，可经历过刚才的惨败，也清楚知道彼此的差距，没有贸然硬拼。
嗖、嗖、嗖！
content_en:
The whole place fell into dead silence, and even the air seemed to be frozen by black ice.
Killing Shura with a snap of a finger, what kind of terrifying combat power is this? !
The powerful elder Juekong could not help but feel in a trance at this moment, unable to believe this cruel reality.
"He hasn't broken through to the Great Luo Realm yet, why is he so powerful?"
Cang Hao's mind was spinning, and everything seemed to be reborn deep in his pupils, and he was rehearsing the scene just now.
Since he reached the perfection of the five qi, he has been polishing for 80,000 cold and heat, and finally reached the legendary extreme state of essence, qi, and spirit.
The Immortal King of Ten Thousand Tribulations once personally asserted: Looking at the ancient and modern worlds, his foundation is enough to rank among the top twenty, which can be said to be the pinnacle.
With the Immortal King's vast knowledge, he would naturally not be mistaken - in other words, his attainments in the field of golden immortals were no less than those of the Immortal King in his youth!
However...
"There's a world of difference...the gap between me and him is at least two levels apart!"
Cang Hao frowned and came to a breathtaking conclusion.
....
And on the opposite side.
Seeing that Yanjing Shura was pierced with one finger, the remaining four old demons had already suffered from liver and gallbladder splitting, and cold air was rising from the soles of their feet.
"The middle stage of Daluo... No, this is definitely the combat power that only the late stage of Daluo can have!"
Not long ago, they had just witnessed the grand occasion when the head of their family took action and severely damaged Ling Jiuxiao.
Although Shen Yun is still a little less mature than the powerful ones like the Five Hells God of War, there is no doubt that he is already on the same level!
What's even more frightening is that this boy is not even a Da Luo Jinxian now. Once he is allowed to successfully overcome the tribulation, his combat power will definitely undergo a qualitative leap. By then, who else in the sky and on earth can control him?
"We must not let him break through, otherwise the consequences will be disastrous!"
In just a moment, Juekong understood the pros and cons, and murderous intent boiled in his eyes.
Wow! !
Without any hesitation, he directly ignited the space law and suppressed the injuries in his body.
Facing such an unprecedented formidable enemy, any slackness would be fatal. Naturally, he would not make such a stupid mistake.
The next moment, the terrifying aspects of Da Luo's peak were nakedly displayed in front of everyone.
"Death——!!"
Absolute air penetrated Changhong, and eight holes all around him opened up. The majestic demonic power surged out, causing the entire Nirvana Valley to rumble.
The five elements, yin and yang, life and death, wind and thunder...the thousands of laws that make up the order of the universe all arise and die and are reorganized according to his thoughts!
boom!
The majestic Dao power was sublimated to the extreme, and finally turned into a cold spatial prison of death. With a sense of oppression that crushed all things, it attacked Shen Yun from all directions.
"The clock of good fortune is beautiful, and the yin and yang are separated by the dusk."
Shen Yun, who was in the center of the storm, still looked calm and unfazed.
He did not attack head-on, but drew a mysterious trajectory in the void with his hands, evolving a Yin-Yang Dao diagram, intending to use his strength to move a thousand pounds.
Obviously, he has seen the essence of Jue Kong's strong external force and is ready to fight a protracted war.
boom! !
However, in the face of the violent mixed space hole, the Yin and Yang Law was weakened a lot after all. In just a few breaths, the divine map exploded cracks and spread at a speed visible to the naked eye.
"He leaves no room for anything once he strikes. He is worthy of being an ancestor of the royal family."
Cang Hao's eyes were like lightning, taking in all of Juekong's almost crazy offensive, and he quickly weighed the pros and cons in his mind.
Uh-huh!
The next moment, his body suddenly rose up and turned into a bright arc of electricity, rushing straight towards the four demons.
Cang Hao felt clear in his heart: with his current cultivation level, he was unable to influence the battle situation on Chen Yun's side. In this case, it would be better to clear out the miscellaneous soldiers first, and then wait for the opportunity to act.
"Damn it! He actually treats us as weak persimmons."
The demons were furious when they saw this, but after experiencing the tragic defeat just now, they knew the gap between them clearly and did not fight rashly.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!
